headline: Srebrenica survivor Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death
context: Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death with NPR's Scott Simon. All of Hrustanovic's adult male relatives died in the Srebrenica Massacre engineered by Mladic.
